column1: # Labels for the text after the first sentence of each 2+ sentence response (items from trailing_items.jsonl).
# Labeled blind to which model produced each item, 2026-10-11.
#   true   every claim the trailing text makes about the evidence or the question is correct
#   false  at least one claim about the evidence or the question is wrong or unsupported: it says something
#          is not stated when the evidence states it, says the question asks something it does not ask,
#          attributes text to a source the evidence does not name, contradicts the evidence, or computes
#          a value the evidence does not support
#   na     the trailing text makes no claim about the evidence or the question
#   evidence_comment  comments on the evidence or the question beyond the answer itself
#   answer            continues or completes the answer
#   other             remark about the answer's support, or a refusal
#   y  the label depends on a reading another annotator could reasonably make differently
